verdict.rationale: Notte documents a full public API with Bearer-token authentication, API reference pages (e.g., agent-start endpoint), SDKs, CLI, and MCP server for programmatic/agentic control of sessions, scraping, and functions, matching the ai-native/agenticness story well. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s on probe) and no independent third-party confirmation of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
